classification.difficultyReason: Find the probabilities of no rain and of attendance given rain, then weight attendance under each weather condition and add the two contributions.

content.prompt: The probability that it will rain on Monday is $0.8$. If it rains, the probability that an employee will be absent is $0.25$. If it does not rain, the probability that the employee will be at work is $0.9$. Find the probability that the employee will be at work on Monday.

answer.worked:
Let $R$ be the event that it rains and $W$ the event that the employee is at work. The employee is at work on either a rainy or a rain-free Monday.

$$\begin{align*}P(W\mid R)&=1-0.25\\ P(W\mid R)&=0.75\\ P(W)&=0.8(0.75)+(1-0.8)(0.9)\\ P(W)&=0.60+0.18\\ P(W)&=\frac{39}{50}\end{align*}$$
